confidence_notes: Restaurant anchors rest on partial evidence: Positano-specific menu fragments, a 2026 Italian price guide, and Italian tourist-area figures. No Positano beer or cappuccino price was verified, so beer, coffee, cocktail and wine are inferred from national, Rome, Venice and Sorrento figures plus a resort premium. The EUR-to-USD conversion (about 1.15) is an unsourced assumption. Hostel anchors are weak because few registered hostels operate in Positano. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no live booking pages or listings were inspected. The FX observation comes from search excerpts of the RBA exchange rates page, not a directly opened RBA table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Positano is priced as a high-demand Amalfi Coast resort town. Food and drink anchors use Italian tourist-area price points (Sorrento, Rome and Venice tourist zones) with a resort premium, and restaurant meals use Positano guide ranges including the cover charge. Accommodation uses a holistic July peak-season estimate for an Amalfi Coast village.
